steps.instructions: 1 - Legionnaire's Bracer - These drop off the Legionnaires of the Deathfist and Crushbone orcs. They're rather rare if you try to hunt legos in the Commonlands, the quickest way to get your bracer is to go to Crushbone (from Greater Faydark). There, they seem to drop like candy.

steps.name: 1 - Greater Lightstone - Willowisp type mobs drop these. The GLS is semi-rare, but not too hard
steps.instructions: 1 - Greater Lightstone - Willowisp type mobs drop these. The GLS is semi-rare, but not too hard to get if you hunt the wisps for a half hour or so. Alternatively, just send out an auction in West Commons. There are always people buying and selling lightstones there for a few plat.

steps.name: 1 - Blackened Sapphire ("the Sapphire of Souls") - This can be found on Ekeros in the Najena du
steps.instructions: 1 - Blackened Sapphire ("the Sapphire of Souls") - This can be found on Ekeros in the Najena dungeon. Ekeros is a somewhat rare spawn, you can find him in the room just outside Rathyl's room. Note: a key is needed to get to Ekeros' spawn point. You can either get the key from another player, or you'll have to go after them yourself. Najena has a sequence of keys that open up deeper and deeper parts of the dungeon to you. The Ogre guards drop Guard's Keyring, the first one you'll need. BoneCracker drops another key, The Guard Captain drops a third. These are the only keys you need to get into Rathyl's area (Rathyl himself drops another key that leads you further in toward Najena's room).

The Sapphire of Souls is the Blackened Sapphire (identifies as "Sapphire of Souls"), dropped by Ekeros in Najena (-161, -47, -22). Bring them back along with your Orange Sash of Order. steps.name: Obtain Incandescent Mask
steps.instructions:
Sultin needs four items:
* Glowing Mask, found on a froglok scryer or a skeleton monk in Upper Guk
* Rune of Fortune (top), from Enynti in the Chasm below Mistmoore
* Rune of Fortune (bottom) by giving 5 pp to Mizr N`Mar in Neriak Third Gate
* Rune of Fortune (middle) by giving 5 pp to Madame Serena in South Qeynos

You say, 'I am interested in the mask

: Sultin says, 'An item of power! The incandescent mask.  If you will bring me the components to make another, I will give you my own incandescent mask.  I will need a glowing mask, found on the skeletal monk in the caverns of Guk.  I will also need all three runes of fortune.  One rune can be found on the dark elf Enynti in the chasm below Castle Mistmoore.  The other two can be purchased for 50 golden coins, one from Mizr N'Mar in the Neriak City Library and the other from Madam Serena in the city of Qeynos.  Bring me all three runes and the glowing mask and I will give you your reward.'

Kill a froglok scryer or a skeleton monk in Upper Guk for the Glowing Mask.

Kill the Dark Elf Enynti in the Chasm below Mistmoore for the Rune of Fortune (top).

Hand 5 platinum pieces to Mizr N`Mar in the Neriak City Library: 

: Mizr N`Mar says, 'Ahhh - gold.  Here is the rune you desire.'

Mizr N`Mar gives you the Rune of Fortune (bottom). 

In South Qeynos, behind the Mermaid's Lure near the dock, hand 5 platinum pieces to Madame Serena: 

: Madame Serena says, 'Fifty gold?  You must want a rune of fortune.  If you want another one, give fifty gold to Mizr N'Mar in the Neriak library.'

Madame Serena give you the Rune of Fortune (middle). 

Go back to The Temple of Solusek Ro and give the Glowing Mask and the three different Runes of Fortune to Sultin:

: Sultin says, 'Fortune favors you .. as will this mask.'

 
* Your faction standing with Temple Of Sol Ro has been adjusted by 5.
* Your faction standing with Shadowed Men has been adjusted by -1.
 

You receive the .

steps.name: Obtain Incandescent Gloves
steps.instructions:
Obtain the following for Sultin:
* Glowing Gloves from a shadowed man
* Radiant Gloves from Radiant in The Temple of Cazic-Thule
* Enchanted Gloves by giving 5 pp to Tizina in Lavastorm Mountains
* Gleaming Gloves by giving a bloodstone to Tarn Visilin in Highpass Keep

You say, 'I am interested in the gloves

: Sultin says, 'My personal favorite! Incandescent gloves.  If you bring me the components to make another pair, I will give you my gloves.  Incandescent gloves are made by sewing together four other sets of gloves.  Glowing gloves can be found on our mortal enemies, the shadowed men.  Radiant gloves can be found on Radiant in the mazes of Cazic-Thule.  Enchanted and gleaming gloves can be purchased for 50 golden coins from Tizina of the Lavastorm gypsies and a bloodstone from Tarn Vislin of High Keep.  Bring me all four sets of gloves and I will give you a pair of incandescent ones.'

Shadowed men can be found in many zones. Glowing Gloves drom randomly from any of them.

Kill Radiant in The Temple of Cazic-Thule and loot the Radiant Gloves.

Go to Lavastorm Mountains and give 5 platinum pieces to Tizina, and she gives you the Enchanted Gloves:

: Tizina says, 'Since you have given me gold, I will give you gloves.  For more magic gloves, give a bloodstone to Tarn Visilin in the High Keep library.'

In Highpass Keep, get the Gleaming Gloves by giving a bloodstone to Tarn Visilin: 

: Tarn Visilin says, 'The gleam of blood - and now the gleam of gloves.'

Take all 4 gloves back to The Temple of Solusek Ro and give them to Sultin:

: Sultin says, 'Four pairs of gloves you have given me ? I will give you one pair in return.  We shall see who had the better deal.'

 
* Your faction standing with Temple Of Sol Ro has been adjusted by 5.
* Your faction standing with Shadowed Men has been adjusted by -1.
 

You receive the .

steps.instructions: Give the listed ingredients to Romar Sunto in Temple of Solusek Ro.

steps.name: Obtain Staff of Temperate Flux
steps.instructions:
The quest start in Temple of Solusek Ro. Gardern is on a balcony at  near the spell vendors.

You say, 'Hail, Gardern'

: Gardern says 'I am Gardern, listed among the chosen of Solusek Ro. I hold the [lore to the staff] of Temperate Flux and the [lore] to the Weeping [Wand] - items which are highly coveted by my wizardly brethren.'

You say, 'What lore to the staff?'

: Gardern says 'The staff of Temperate Flux is a boon to those who dabble in the elemental arts, for it can increase the susceptibility of a creature to both fire and cold. Are you [interested] in the [staff]?'

You say, 'I am interested in the staff.'

: Gardern says 'I will craft you a staff of Temperate Flux, but you must bring me the components I require to make it. I will need a heart of fire from an inferno goblin wizard in the caverns of Solusek, a heart of frost from a goblin wizard in the caverns of Permafrost, a rod of bone from a stone skeleton by the shores of Lake Rathe and a Staff of Ro. Bring me these items, and I will make you your staff.'

He wants four items:
* Darkwood Staff obtained by giving Romar Sunto in Temple of Solusek Ro a Lambent Stone
* Heart of Fire from inferno goblin wizard in Solusek's Eye (Sol A)
* Heart of Frost from a goblin wizard in Permafrost
* Rod of Bone from a stone skeleton in Lake Rathetear (note: Rod of Bone, not Heart of Stone)

Hand in the four items:

: Gardern says 'Well done, ______ - here is the staff of Temperate Flux. Use it with the blessings of the Temple of Solusek Ro.'

Note:

The most difficult part of this quest is getting the Rod of Bone in Lake Rathetear. Stone Skeletons spawn in a tower in the southeast corner of the zone. There are two of them, very close to each other. They both have earth pet, who cast Root. So, you will have trouble single pulling them, which makes soloing this part mostly impossible before level 30 (while the skeletons are level 24-26). You might want to look for another wizard in his 20's or get a few partners to help you for this part.

Note: At lvl 29 you can use Bonds of Force (aoe snare) on one of the pets, and then run to zone. At zone root the stone skeleton and zone dance, then root the pet again and quickly burst down stone skeleton. Use leatherskin.

Note: The above method did not work for me. However, I found a method that does, and I was able to solo them at 31 with a Stein of Moggok as my only int g
Full walkthrough: https://eqlwiki.com/Staff_of_Temperate_Flux_Quest

quests.name: Stein of Ulissa

steps.name: Obtain Stein of Ulissa
steps.instructions:
Vira may be found on the balcony to the left, at +410, +85. She will give quest dialog and rewards to a level 10 Magician as of 9/29/2019 (perhaps lower).

You say, 'Hail, Vira'

: Vira says 'I am Vira, elementalist of Solusek Ro. I guard the secrets of the tools of [elemental summoning]. If you are a magician, you might be interested.'

You say, 'What is elemental summoning?'

: Vira says 'I hold the secrets to the construction of four tools which assist magicians with the summoning of elementals. I know about the [broom of Trilon], the [shovel of Ponz], the [torch of Alna] and the [stein of Ulissa].'

You say, 'What of the stein of Ulissa?'

: Vira says 'The stein of Ulissa was found and used by the mistress of water of the same name.  Are you [interested] in the [stein]?'

You say, 'I am interested in the stein.'

: Vira says 'I will devise a replica of the stein of Ulissa for you, but I will need the following items to make it: a sapphire, a scale from a mermaid, a stein from a magician in Najena and the toes of an ice giant.  Bring me these four components, and I will make for you an object of elemental power.'

She wants the following four items:

* A Sapphire may be purchased from a jewelry merchant. 
* A Mermaid Scale drops from various mermaids around the world. 
* A Stein (of Water) drops from magicians in Najena or alligators in Cazic Thule or Lake Rathetear.
* Ice Giant Toes drop from various ice giants around the old world (everfrost, permafrost, Gornit in ocean of tears). These are not to be confused with Frost Giant Toes which drop from Velious giants.

Turn in the four items:

: Vira says 'The four components required for the stein of Ulissa?!  I am impressed!  As you have displayed valor, I grant you this stein.'

 
* Your faction standing with Temple Of Sol Ro got better.
* Your faction standing with Shadowed Men got worse.
 

You receive the .

steps.name: Obtain White Dragonscale Cloak
steps.instructions:
Karam wants the following items:

* White Dragon Hide - from Lady Vox
* Platinum Diamond Wedding Ring - Jewelcrafting
* Black Sapphire Platinum Necklace - Jewelcrafting

Note: These need to be the magical version, not the regular ones.

== Dialogue ==

You say, 'Hail, Karam Dragonforge'

: Karam Dragonforge says 'Welcome. I have a number of platemail items, if you are interested. I am also a master [smith] of exotic materials such as dragon scales.'

You say, 'Smith what?'

: Karam Dragonforge says 'Dragon scales make terrfic armor. I can make a [white dragonscale cloak] and [red dragonscale armor]. I have not seen any other colored dragon variants around. But if you see any, be sure to let me know. I would be interested in what can be made from their scales.'

You say, 'What white dragonscale cloak?'

: Karam Dragonforge says 'Hrmmm. A white dragonscale cloak eh? Hrmmm. Well, I will make you a deal. You can save me some footwork and I will craft your cloak. I want to propose to my [fiancee] but I have neither a [wedding ring] nor a [present] for her. So, return with a white dragon hide, a [wedding ring], and a [present] for my fiancee, and I will fashion your cloak for you.'

You say, 'What fiancee?'

: Karam Dragonforge says 'My fiancee... AHHHH.... The love of my life. My purpose for existing. She is a real woman. Long, golden blonde hair with a similarly colored full beard. A stout broad she is, kind and warm at heart. She knows every nook of my essence. But do not let that fool you. She is as strong as many dwarven men. Between you and me, she has even beaten me once or twice armwrestling over who gets the last ale and who has to go to the market.'

You say, 'What wedding ring?'

: Karam Dragonforge says 'Only the best will do. I will not propose to her with anything less than a platinum and diamond wedding ring.'

You say, 'What present?'

: Karam Dragonforge says 'Well, she is quite fond of jewelry. And a black sapphire platinum necklace would complement her eyes and beard so exquisitely.'

After turn in:

: Karam Dragonforge says 'My fiance will be so excited! An exquisite ring for the wedding and a gorgeous necklace as my wedding gift to her. Well, as promised, here is your White Dragonscale Cloak.'

steps.name: Deliver the blessing and enter the castle
steps.instructions: Give Blessing of the Betrayer to Retainer Ozval, then follow the road north and click the castle gates.

quests.name: The Tragic Tale of House Everling

steps.name: Hear Lord Ollix Everling's request
steps.instructions: Inside the castle, hail Lord Ollix Everling near the ruined harpsichord and ask about "dead". His exact coordinates remain undocumented.

steps.name: Collect Harpsichord Black Key
steps.instructions: Pick up Harpsichord Black Key at (-37, 130) in Nektropos Castle. Southwest chessboard, in front of The Game Master. Coordinates describe the ground item, not the nearby NPC.

steps.name: Collect Harpsichord White Key
steps.instructions: Pick up Harpsichord White Key at (710, 105) in Nektropos Castle. Northwest storage area with boxes. Coordinates describe the ground item, not the nearby NPC.

steps.name: Collect Harpsichord String
steps.instructions: Pick up Harpsichord String at (120, -151) in Nektropos Castle. Southeast Tormentor room. Coordinates describe the ground item, not the nearby NPC.

steps.name: Collect Harpsichord Plectrum
steps.instructions: Pick up Harpsichord Plectrum at (-23, -100) in Nektropos Castle. Southeast Priestess room. Coordinates describe the ground item, not the nearby NPC.

steps.name: Combine the Nektropos Library Key
steps.instructions: At the ruined harpsichord in the main lobby, (368, 65), combine the four harpsichord components. This is a quest-object combine, not evidence of a tradeskill recipe.

steps.name: Make contact with Ollix's mother
steps.instructions: Find Lady Sileniu Everling in the northeast second-floor chambers at (552, -132, 17).

steps.name: Hear Lady Everling's plea
steps.instructions: Ask Lady Sileniu Everling about "He", then "swear". This starts The Betrayer.

steps.name: Complete The Betrayer
steps.instructions: Follow The Betrayer's separately documented route through the sisters, Alexa and Lord Rikantus, then say "end" to Plimptos. The nested quest grants Blood's Unity; the parent does not establish a second copy.

steps.name: Confess to Lady Sileniu Everling
steps.instructions: Tell Lady Sileniu Everling "dead", then "confess". Defeat her after she turns hostile.

steps.name: Return to Lord Ollix Everling
steps.instructions: Return to Lord Ollix Everling and say "tragic". The source records completion of the House Everling achievement.

quests.name: The Betrayer

steps.name: Accept Lady Everling's task
steps.instructions: Speak to Lady Sileniu Everling near (552, -132, 17): "He", then "swear".

steps.name: Hear Plimptos' account
steps.instructions: Find Plimptos downstairs at (102, -151, 7); say "crimes", then "brought back" for the sword hilt.

steps.name: Speak to Alexa's Handmaiden
steps.instructions: Hail Alexa's Handmaiden in the southeast second-floor area near (172, -178).

steps.name: Defeat the six sisters
steps.instructions: Defeat Jenni, Melanie, Crysta, Shelia, Elise and Deirdre Everling. Recorded locations: Jenni (342, -423, 17); Crysta (859, 311, 18); Shelia (352, 428, 17); Elise (-157, 321, 17). Exact Melanie/Deirdre coordinates remain undocumented.

steps.name: Return for the Great Room Key
steps.instructions: Hail Alexa's Handmaiden again to receive Nektropos Great Room Key.

steps.name: Defeat Alexa Everling
steps.instructions: Defeat Alexa in the southwest second-floor great room to obtain Nektropos Private Chamber Key. Her exact coordinates remain undocumented.

steps.name: Find the basement entrance
steps.instructions: Use the secret entrance behind the bookshelf in the Guard Captain's northwest second-floor room. Exact captain coordinates remain undocumented.

steps.name: Defeat The Juggernaught
steps.instructions: Follow the basement corridor southwest to The Juggernaught at (-331, 310, -112) for Nektropos Basement Key.

steps.name: Defeat Lord Rikantus Everling
steps.instructions: Defeat Lord Rikantus Everling beside the Juggernaught room at (-382, 181, -112). Wiki combat notes describe golem phases; these are guidance, not a Catalyst damage formula.

steps.name: Return to Plimptos
steps.instructions: Say "end" to Plimptos. Blood's Unity is the documented quest reward. Then resume the House Everling quest.

sources.notes: https://eqlwiki.com/Incandescent_Armor_Quests revision 175766

Sultin needs four items:
* Glowing Mask, found on a froglok scryer or a skeleton monk in Upper Guk
* Rune of Fortune (top), from Enynti in the Chasm below Mistmoore
* Rune of Fortune (bottom) by giving 5 pp to Mizr N`Mar in Neriak Third Gate
* Rune of Fortune (middle) by giving 5 pp to Madame Serena in South Qeynos

You say, 'I am interested in the mask

: Sultin says, 'An item of power! The incandescent mask.  If you will bring me the components to make another, I will give you my own incandescent mask.  I will need a glowing mask, found on the skeletal monk in the caverns of Guk.  I will also need all three runes of fortune.  One rune can be found on the dark elf Enynti in the chasm below Castle Mistmoore.  The other two can be purchased for 50 golden coins, one from Mizr N'Mar in the Neriak City Library and the other from Madam Serena in the city of Qeynos.  Bring me all three runes and the glowing mask and I will give you your reward.'

Kill a froglok scryer or a skeleton monk in Upper Guk for the Glowing Mask.

Kill the Dark Elf Enynti in the Chasm below Mistmoore for the Rune of Fortune (top).

Hand 5 platinum pieces to Mizr N`Mar in the Neriak City Library: 

: Mizr N`Mar says, 'Ahhh - gold.  Here is the rune you desire.'

Mizr N`Mar gives you the Rune of Fortune (bottom). 

In South Qeynos, behind the Mermaid's Lure near the dock, hand 5 platinum pieces to Madame Serena: 

: Madame Serena says, 'Fifty gold?  You must want a rune of fortune.  If you want another one, give fifty gold to Mizr N'Mar in the Neriak library.'

Madame Serena give you the Rune of Fortune (middle). 

Go back to The Temple of Solusek Ro and give the Glowing Mask and the three different Runes of Fortune to Sultin:

: Sultin says, 'Fortune favors you .. as will this mask.'

 
* Your faction standing with Temple Of Sol Ro has been adjusted by 5.
* Your faction standing with Shadowed Men has been adjusted by -1.
 

You receive the .

sources.notes: https://eqlwiki.com/Incandescent_Armor_Quests revision 175766

Obtain the following for Sultin:
* Glowing Gloves from a shadowed man
* Radiant Gloves from Radiant in The Temple of Cazic-Thule
* Enchanted Gloves by giving 5 pp to Tizina in Lavastorm Mountains
* Gleaming Gloves by giving a bloodstone to Tarn Visilin in Highpass Keep

You say, 'I am interested in the gloves

: Sultin says, 'My personal favorite! Incandescent gloves.  If you bring me the components to make another pair, I will give you my gloves.  Incandescent gloves are made by sewing together four other sets of gloves.  Glowing gloves can be found on our mortal enemies, the shadowed men.  Radiant gloves can be found on Radiant in the mazes of Cazic-Thule.  Enchanted and gleaming gloves can be purchased for 50 golden coins from Tizina of the Lavastorm gypsies and a bloodstone from Tarn Vislin of High Keep.  Bring me all four sets of gloves and I will give you a pair of incandescent ones.'

Shadowed men can be found in many zones. Glowing Gloves drom randomly from any of them.

Kill Radiant in The Temple of Cazic-Thule and loot the Radiant Gloves.

Go to Lavastorm Mountains and give 5 platinum pieces to Tizina, and she gives you the Enchanted Gloves:

: Tizina says, 'Since you have given me gold, I will give you gloves.  For more magic gloves, give a bloodstone to Tarn Visilin in the High Keep library.'

In Highpass Keep, get the Gleaming Gloves by giving a bloodstone to Tarn Visilin: 

: Tarn Visilin says, 'The gleam of blood - and now the gleam of gloves.'

Take all 4 gloves back to The Temple of Solusek Ro and give them to Sultin:

: Sultin says, 'Four pairs of gloves you have given me ? I will give you one pair in return.  We shall see who had the better deal.'

 
* Your faction standing with Temple Of Sol Ro has been adjusted by 5.
* Your faction standing with Shadowed Men has been adjusted by -1.
 

You receive the .

: Tarn Visilin says, 'The gleam of blood - and now the gleam of gloves.'

Take all 4 gloves back to The Temple of Solusek Ro and give them to Sultin:

: Sultin says, 'Four pairs of gloves you have given me ? I will give you one pair in return.  We shall see who had the better deal.'

 
* Your faction standing with Temple Of Sol Ro has been adjusted by 5.
* Your faction standing with Shadowed Men has been adjusted by -1.

sources.evidenceId: classic-v1:staff of temperate flux:Temple of Solusek Ro:Gardern:Quest
sources.notes: https://eqlwiki.com/Staff_of_Temperate_Flux_Quest revision 175510

The quest start in Temple of Solusek Ro. Gardern is on a balcony at  near the spell vendors.

You say, 'Hail, Gardern'

: Gardern says 'I am Gardern, listed among the chosen of Solusek Ro. I hold the [lore to the staff] of Temperate Flux and the [lore] to the Weeping [Wand] - items which are highly coveted by my wizardly brethren.'

You say, 'What lore to the staff?'

: Gardern says 'The staff of Temperate Flux is a boon to those who dabble in the elemental arts, for it can increase the susceptibility of a creature to both fire and cold. Are you [interested] in the [staff]?'

You say, 'I am interested in the staff.'

: Gardern says 'I will craft you a staff of Temperate Flux, but you must bring me the components I require to make it. I will need a heart of fire from an inferno goblin wizard in the caverns of Solusek, a heart of frost from a goblin wizard in the caverns of Permafrost, a rod of bone from a stone skeleton by the shores of Lake Rathe and a Staff of Ro. Bring me these items, and I will make you your staff.'

He wants four items:
* Darkwood Staff obtained by giving Romar Sunto in Temple of Solusek Ro a Lambent Stone
* Heart of Fire from inferno goblin wizard in Solusek's Eye (Sol A)
* Heart of Frost from a goblin wizard in Permafrost
* Rod of Bone from a stone skeleton in Lake Rathetear (note: Rod of Bone, not Heart of Stone)

Hand in the four items:

: Gardern says 'Well done, ______ - here is the staff of Temperate Flux. Use it with the blessings of the Temple of Solusek Ro.'

Note:

The most difficult part of this quest is getting the Rod of Bone in Lake Rathetear. Stone Skeletons spawn in a tower in the southeast corner of the zone. There are two of them, very close to each other. They both have earth pet, who cast Root. So, you will have trouble single pulling them, which makes soloing this part mostly impossible before level 30 (while the skeletons are level 24-26). You might want to look for another wizard in his 20's or get a few partners to help you for this part.

Note: At lvl 29 you can use Bonds of Force (aoe snare) on one of the pets, and then run to zone. At zone root the stone skeleton and zone dance, then root the pet again and quickly burst down stone skeleton. Use leatherskin.

Note: The above method did not work for me. However, I found a method that does, and I was able to solo them at 31 with a Stein of Moggok as my only int g
Full walkthrough: https://eqlwiki.com/Staff_of_Temperate_Flux_Quest

sources.evidenceId: classic-v1:stein of ulissa:Temple of Solusek Ro:Vira:Quest
sources.notes: https://eqlwiki.com/Stein_Of_Ulissa_Quest revision 169588

Vira may be found on the balcony to the left, at +410, +85. She will give quest dialog and rewards to a level 10 Magician as of 9/29/2019 (perhaps lower).

You say, 'Hail, Vira'

: Vira says 'I am Vira, elementalist of Solusek Ro. I guard the secrets of the tools of [elemental summoning]. If you are a magician, you might be interested.'

You say, 'What is elemental summoning?'

: Vira says 'I hold the secrets to the construction of four tools which assist magicians with the summoning of elementals. I know about the [broom of Trilon], the [shovel of Ponz], the [torch of Alna] and the [stein of Ulissa].'

You say, 'What of the stein of Ulissa?'

: Vira says 'The stein of Ulissa was found and used by the mistress of water of the same name.  Are you [interested] in the [stein]?'

You say, 'I am interested in the stein.'

: Vira says 'I will devise a replica of the stein of Ulissa for you, but I will need the following items to make it: a sapphire, a scale from a mermaid, a stein from a magician in Najena and the toes of an ice giant.  Bring me these four components, and I will make for you an object of elemental power.'

She wants the following four items:

* A Sapphire may be purchased from a jewelry merchant. 
* A Mermaid Scale drops from various mermaids around the world. 
* A Stein (of Water) drops from magicians in Najena or alligators in Cazic Thule or Lake Rathetear.
* Ice Giant Toes drop from various ice giants around the old world (everfrost, permafrost, Gornit in ocean of tears). These are not to be confused with Frost Giant Toes which drop from Velious giants.

Turn in the four items:

: Vira says 'The four components required for the stein of Ulissa?!  I am impressed!  As you have displayed valor, I grant you this stein.'

 
* Your faction standing with Temple Of Sol Ro got better.
* Your faction standing with Shadowed Men got worse.
 

You receive the .

Karam wants the following items:

* White Dragon Hide - from Lady Vox
* Platinum Diamond Wedding Ring - Jewelcrafting
* Black Sapphire Platinum Necklace - Jewelcrafting

Note: These need to be the magical version, not the regular ones.

== Dialogue ==

You say, 'Hail, Karam Dragonforge'

: Karam Dragonforge says 'Welcome. I have a number of platemail items, if you are interested. I am also a master [smith] of exotic materials such as dragon scales.'

You say, 'Smith what?'

: Karam Dragonforge says 'Dragon scales make terrfic armor. I can make a [white dragonscale cloak] and [red dragonscale armor]. I have not seen any other colored dragon variants around. But if you see any, be sure to let me know. I would be interested in what can be made from their scales.'

You say, 'What white dragonscale cloak?'

: Karam Dragonforge says 'Hrmmm. A white dragonscale cloak eh? Hrmmm. Well, I will make you a deal. You can save me some footwork and I will craft your cloak. I want to propose to my [fiancee] but I have neither a [wedding ring] nor a [present] for her. So, return with a white dragon hide, a [wedding ring], and a [present] for my fiancee, and I will fashion your cloak for you.'

You say, 'What fiancee?'

: Karam Dragonforge says 'My fiancee... AHHHH.... The love of my life. My purpose for existing. She is a real woman. Long, golden blonde hair with a similarly colored full beard. A stout broad she is, kind and warm at heart. She knows every nook of my essence. But do not let that fool you. She is as strong as many dwarven men. Between you and me, she has even beaten me once or twice armwrestling over who gets the last ale and who has to go to the market.'

You say, 'What wedding ring?'

: Karam Dragonforge says 'Only the best will do. I will not propose to her with anything less than a platinum and diamond wedding ring.'

You say, 'What present?'

: Karam Dragonforge says 'Well, she is quite fond of jewelry. And a black sapphire platinum necklace would complement her eyes and beard so exquisitely.'

After turn in:

: Karam Dragonforge says 'My fiance will be so excited! An exquisite ring for the wedding and a gorgeous necklace as my wedding gift to her. Well, as promised, here is your White Dragonscale Cloak.'
